name: topology_run_ooda_cycle
description: Execute an autonomous multi-loop OODA cycle or advance stages with automated cross-model deliberation, voting synthesis, invariant validation, and DAG synchronization.

planId.description: Plan ID to execute OODA cycle on

targetStage.description: Specific stage to run, or omit to auto-advance to next sequential stage

runFullLoop.description: If true, runs all remaining stages in sequence for this iteration loop

convergenceThreshold.description: Target consensus percentage (0-100) required to declare convergence

contextNotes.description: Optional operational context, findings, or observations
